title: What guests wrote after the paddle
why: Review spotlight from recent Google reviews for warm leads comparing bat tours; proof without stat claims.
hook_options: Six guests. Their words, not ours.
What people say an hour after the bats
Read these before you book a bat tour
caption: Straight from our Google reviews: bucket lists, first-timers, a company retreat and one honest warning about wet shoes. Bat season runs until early November. #austinkayaktours #austinbats #ladybirdlake #austinreviews

slides.headline: What guests wrote after the paddle
slides.body: First names and last initials only. Guide names left out, because the guests said it better anyway.

slides.headline: "Bucket list"
slides.body: "We thoroughly enjoyed watching the bats from kayaks on Lady Bird Lake." And: "Our experience made it into the next day's conversations."

slides.headline: Bats over Congress Avenue at dusk
slides.body: The colony roosts under the bridge until early November. Wild, so never guaranteed.

slides.headline: Watching them emerge from below
slides.body: Her highlight: "The vantage of watching the bats emerge from below." Plus: "Easy to find with good food nearby."

slides.headline: First time kayaking. No problem.
slides.body: "Their instructions for beginners was all I needed to become a proficient kayaker."

slides.headline: "We saw SO MANY BATS!"
slides.body: Capitals hers. "It was amazing!" Bat nights vary. She got a big one.

slides.headline: Team building people actually liked
slides.body: Her team booked a tour for a company retreat: "it was so fun!" Singles or tandems, your pick.

slides.headline: "Your butt and legs/feet will get wet"
slides.body: "...so plan accordingly." Fair. Quick-dry clothes and shoes that can get soaked.

slides.headline: "Relaxed but informative"
slides.body: "We had a great afternoon on the lake!" Calm water, a guide who knows the city, two easy hours.

slides.headline: Come see what they saw
slides.body: Sunset bat and skyline tours on Lady Bird Lake. Book at austinkayaktours.com.
